items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 16:1
items.html: (To the question) Only the lights that came out from the coupling of Gadlut of AVI were annulled, but what was in AVI from the beginning of their emanation, nothing at all was annulled. (p. 509, Item 31)
